scope: 99 existing synthetic seed examples, reviewed for a bounded local development pilot
authorization_interpretation: Permits a resource-capped local fine-tuning experiment after presenting its estimate; does not authorize public release or unlimited training.
checks: Inspected the complete data generator and explicit examples
Arithmetic references independently computable and correct
JSON and Python examples are static literals or simple functions
No private chat logs, audio or user biography imported
Project creator attribution comes from the owner-provided project context
All prompt tokens masked; same neutral system prompt used for pilot training and evaluation
limits: Template-related train/validation rows are not a fully independent generalization measure
Uncertainty examples are generic and may not transfer reliably
No evaluation rows, responses or expected answers are used as training targets
